title: Raising the daily AI cap in code without raising the database ceiling fails a test instead of stopping every paid AI call

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), AI accounting review of #3345 and #3355 (LIVE-883).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: GLOBAL_DAILY_CAP_USD = 25 carries the instruction 'raise as real usage and revenue grow', and lib/ai/accounting.ts passes it to the reservation RPC, which raises 'Invalid AI reservation' whenever p_global_cap > 25. Following the comment alone would stop every paid AI call (fail closed, so no spend leak, but a full outage of Vera and every AI surface). THE FIX: the comment names the SQL ceiling, and lib/ai/budget-ceiling.test.ts fails when the TypeScript cap exceeds the newest ceiling in supabase/migrations.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('lib/ai/budget-ceiling.test.ts')||!/GLOBAL_DAILY_CAP_USD\)\.toBeLessThanOrEqual/.test(fs.readFileSync('lib/ai/budget-ceiling.test.ts','utf8'))){console.error('SCAN-824: nothing couples the TypeScript AI cap to the reservation RPC ceiling');process.exit(1)}"
